fact: At FIDAK 2025 the Treasury (DGCPT) presented Koom Com, an application to give local governments a digital, geolocated census of taxpayers and track each payment from assessment to collection, to be deployed in phases starting with the 125 urban communes.
title: FIDAK 2025 : présentation de l'outil numérique Koom Com pour la digitalisation et l'optimisation de la fiscalité locale
